admission.justification: Spans RecordRow in history.py, _deferral_only_dependent_change in touched_records.py, and record_row_open in predicates.py, and is guarded by writer and gate tests.

applicability: Deferral-only writes on existing dependent records and their corresponding history rows and worklist/gate checks.
conditions: Deferral dispositions (deferred, re_deferred, deferral_lifted) and deferralIds are admitted only on DPD- RecordRow subjects and carry no effect.
A dependent record modified only in deferrals (plus revision and writer) raises a touched_record item with deferralOnly=True answered by a deferral disposition at the candidate revision.
Edited documents continue to require a changed RecordRow and fresh confirmation under changed_document_open.
exclusions: Non-dependent RecordRow subjects, which reject deferral dispositions and deferralIds.
Edited-document confirmation writes, which refresh stands_on and confirmed.
statement: Writing, re-deferring or lifting a deferral leaves a dependent record's stands_on and confirmed untouched, increments revision, records a DPD-only RecordRow with disposition deferred, re_deferred or deferral_lifted and no effect, and preserves rule-5 confirmation matching on edited documents.
title: Deferral operations preserve confirmation and use DPD-only history rows
